register_mcss_directives: register the Image, Figure, and ImageGrid RST directives with m.css settings for a documentation project
create_image_directive: create a custom RST Image directive with scale, width, height, target, and alt text support
create_figure_directive: create a custom RST Figure directive with caption parsing and m-figure CSS class support
create_imagegrid_directive: create an RST ImageGrid directive that auto-sizes images by relative width and extracts EXIF captions
configure_pelican_images: configure the m.css image plugin for Pelican by connecting to the initialized signal
